kpis.description_fr: Capacité installée renouvelables (éolien on/offshore + solaire). Hero KPI Acciona Energia.
kpis.description_en: Renewable installed capacity (wind on/offshore + solar). Acciona Energia hero KPI.

kpis.description_fr: Production annuelle TWh renouvelables. Indicateur output réel vs capacité installée (load factor ~25-30%).
kpis.description_en: Annual TWh renewable production. Real output vs installed capacity indicator (load factor ~25-30%).

kpis.description_fr: Carnet de commandes Infrastructure (Construction). Visibilité ~3 ans, pipeline mega-projets infra.
Volume eau traitée (concessions). KPI Water segment, ~120 dessalinisation/traitement plants worldwide.
kpis.description_en: Water volume treated (concessions). Water segment KPI, ~120 desal/treatment plants worldwide.

kpis.description_fr: Part production sous PPA long terme (vs spot). KPI de-risking revenue, attractivité investisseur.
kpis.description_en: Share of production under long-term PPA (vs spot). Revenue de-risking KPI, investor attractiveness.

kpis_story.description_fr: Reconsidération possible buy-back complet d'Acciona Energia (filiale cotée depuis 2021). Annoncé 2024 sous condition marché, libération valeur via reconsolidation. Décision attendue 2025.
kpis_story.description_en: Possible full buy-back of Acciona Energia (listed subsidiary since 2021) under consideration. Announced 2024 conditional on market, value unlock via reconsolidation. Decision expected 2025.
